description: A build-a-circuit assignment that checks a device state: make the fuse trip within 2 ms. The starting circuit holds the locked ideal 2.02 V source V1, the locked fuse F1 (0.01 Ohm, trip threshold 0.004 A^2*s, the catalog defaults) and a ground marker; the student adds a load. The values are direct circuit equations (the same ones as the Stage 4 fuse fixture).

attempts.name: one-ohm-load
attempts.description: A 1 Ohm load: 2 A while intact, so the fuse reaches 0.004 A^2*s in one public step (1 ms).

attempts.name: ten-ohm-load
attempts.description: A 10 Ohm load: 0.2017982 A, so after 2 ms the accumulated I2t is about 8.1e-5 A^2*s, far below the threshold.

attempts.name: no-load
attempts.description: Nothing added: the loop is open, no current flows, and the fuse stays intact.
